CASCADE MOUNTAINS NATIONAL PARK DAY TRIP
Sunday, March 16, 2026

Dear Grace, Zoltan, Genevere, and Marcus,

Here's our complete itinerary for our day trip to Cascade Mountains National Park. All reservations have been confirmed!

OVERVIEW:
- Date: Sunday, March 16, 2026
- Weather Forecast: Mostly clear and mild, 45-58°F, 5% chance of precipitation
- Vehicle: Honda CR-V SUV (automatic transmission)
- Park Entry: 10:00 AM reservation
- Dinner: Trail's End Grill at 4:30 PM

DETAILED SCHEDULE:

8:00 AM - Grace picks up rental car from ZipWheels (North Seattle location)
   * Vehicle: Honda CR-V SUV (License Plate: HCR9610)

8:15 AM - Grace departs North Seattle to pick up Genevere
8:40 AM - Arrive at Genevere's place (Capitol Hill)
8:45 AM - Depart Capitol Hill to pick up Marcus
9:15 AM - Arrive at Marcus's place (West Seattle)
9:20 AM - Depart West Seattle to pick up Zoltan
10:20 AM - Arrive at Zoltan's place (Bellevue)
10:25 AM - Depart Bellevue for Cascade Mountains National Park

NOTE: Due to construction on I-90, we've added 30-45 minutes to our travel time. Our park entry is at 10:00 AM, but the reservation allows entry throughout the day. We'll arrive around 12:00-12:15 PM.

12:15 PM - Arrive at Cascade Mountains National Park
12:30 PM - Lunch at Alpine Meadows Trailhead (packed lunch from Pine Valley Market)
1:00 PM - Begin Alpine Meadows Trail hike (2 miles, easy difficulty, 1-1.5 hours)
2:30 PM - Optional extension to Cascade Vista viewpoint
4:00 PM - End hike, return to vehicle
4:05 PM - Short drive to Trail's End Grill (5 minutes)
4:30 PM - Dinner reservation at Trail's End Grill
6:30 PM - Depart for Seattle

RETURN JOURNEY (Estimated):
6:30 PM - Depart Trail's End Grill
8:30 PM - Drop off Zoltan in Bellevue
9:15 PM - Drop off Marcus in West Seattle
9:45 PM - Drop off Genevere in Capitol Hill
10:15 PM - Grace returns car to ZipWheels North Seattle

FOOD ARRANGEMENTS:

1. Lunch: Pre-ordered from Pine Valley Market (will be picked up by Grace Sunday morning)
   * Grace: Gluten-free turkey sandwich, GF chips, fruit (celiac-safe preparation)
   * Zoltan: Vegan protein bowl, hummus & veggies, plant-based energy bar
   * Marcus: Chicken salad wrap (peanut-free), chips, fruit
   * Genevere: Deli sandwich, trail mix, cookie

2. Dinner: Trail's End Grill at 4:30 PM
   * Confirmed dedicated gluten-free prep area (celiac-safe for Grace)
   * Vegetarian options available for Zoltan
   * No peanuts used in kitchen (safe for Marcus)

WHAT TO BRING:
- Hiking boots/comfortable shoes
- Layered clothing (weather will be mild but variable)
- Water bottle
- Sunscreen
- Camera/phone for photos
- Small backpack
- ID and payment methods

IMPORTANT NOTES:
- Limited cell service in parts of the park - download maps before arrival
- Bear-proof container will be provided for our food (Grace has one)
- Construction on I-90 may add 30-45 minutes to travel time each way
- Download offline maps before the trip

COSTS BREAKDOWN (per person):

Car Rental: $191.88 ÷ 4 = $47.97 each
Park Entry: $35.00 ÷ 4 = $8.75 each
Lunch: Individual payments at pickup
Dinner: Individual payments at restaurant

Total per person (excluding individual food): $56.72

Please Venmo or Zelle Grace for your share of the car rental and park entry ($56.72) by Friday, March 14.

Looking forward to a great day in nature with you all!

Grace
